Iran signals defiance amid US violations and leadership questions

Iran has stated it will no longer be bound by a deal, citing continued violations by the United States. This declaration comes amidst internal leadership questions and signals a stance of non-surrender to US pressure. The situation highlights ongoing tensions and Iran's position in international relations.
